g.text: Ideal moist-air model; saturation pressures are monotonic interpolation of handbook water-table values, not a full ASHRAE design chart. Horizontal dashed
line reaches dew point at saturation. Red dashed line reaches the thermodynamic wet-bulb point using adiabatic-saturation energy with liquid water at
T_wb; a measured wick wet bulb can differ.
